subject: Request: Temporary Net60 and Short-Term Credit Increase for Atlas Health
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@atlashealth.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, Feb 26 2027 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: Temporary payment terms request for Q2

Hi Logan,

Quick ask from our side as we close Q1 budgets: would Redwood consider a temporary move to Net60 for the next 3 months and a short-term increase to our credit cap to $150k? We're onboarding three pilot teams and procurement needs extended terms so we can align invoices with customer reimbursements.

We can provide an updated PO (attached) and Maria (cc'd procurement) will sign a term amendment. Also note: two of our entities are EU subsidiaries — we'll need VAT-compliant invoices (reverse-charge noted) and the invoices should include our VAT IDs. Can Redwood accommodate both the Net60 and VAT formatting?

Appreciate a quick confirmation so I can update internal stakeholders.

Thanks,
Maria Gonzalez
VP, Finance Operations
Atlas Health

Attachment: atlas_po_2027-02.pdf (PDF, 89 KB)

From: logan_wright@redwood.ai
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@atlashealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, Mar 01 2027 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Temporary payment terms request for Q2

Thanks for the note, Maria — and congrats on the pilot ramp. Short answer: we can likely support Net60 for a limited trial window, but we need to align on a few controls (credit cap, deposit, and VAT documentation).

High-level proposal from our side:
- Temporary Net60 for invoices dated Mar 1–May 31, 2027 (3 months).
- Interim credit cap increase to $150,000 while Net60 is in effect.
- One-month upfront deposit equal to the average invoice (or first invoice) for the pilot as a credit guardrail.
- EU invoices: we'll include customer VAT IDs and a reverse-charge line item, but we need your VAT registration docs for our accounting team.
- Formalize with a short amendment (DocuSign).

I'm looping in Ben (finance) and Marissa (legal/contracts) to finalize the mechanics — Ben, do you need a credit application or internal checklist? Marissa, anything material we should flag for the amendment?

I'll attach a payment schedule proposal for transparency. If that looks OK we can issue the amendment and share the DocuSign link.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: payment_schedule_proposal.xlsx (XLSX, 23 KB)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, Mar 01 2027 11:42:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Temporary payment terms request for Q2

Logan — quick finance notes:
- We can approve a one-time temporary Net60 for 90 days with a hard credit cap of $150k but require either (A) the one-month deposit you proposed or (B) an approved corporate credit memo. Deposit is preferred for speed.
- Please request Atlas to complete the standard credit form (I can send it) and provide their latest audited A/R aging (private vendor docs).
- VAT: for EU reverse-charge we need the VAT numbers and confirmation of the entity that will be billed. Our AP team will only mark reverse-charge when VAT ID and entity mapping are provided.
- Accounting needs the PO number on each invoice (include your PO field in the amendment).

If legal is comfortable with the amendment language, finance can turn this around in 2 business days after receiving the deposit and credit docs.

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@atlashealth.com>, logan_wright@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, Mar 02 2027 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Temporary payment terms request for Q2

Maria — thanks for the clarity. We can proceed with a short amendment that:
- Adds a 90-day Net60 term window (start/end dates called out).
- States the temporary credit cap of $150,000 and the deposit requirement (one-month invoice).
- Requires customer VAT numbers and a clause that Atlas will be responsible for VAT reporting where applicable.
- Requires PO number on each invoice and a statement that invoices must be paid to Redwood's specified remit address.

I'll draft the amendment and load it into DocuSign. Logan — please confirm Atlas will provide the VAT IDs and the deposit method (wire / card). Maria — once we have the deposit and VAT info, we will issue the first Net60 invoice.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial
